head: cloud/check-dependencies-exact
title: fix(ci): require exact dependency inventory rows
body:
`tools/ci/check-dependencies.py` accepted a required component when its name appeared as a case-insensitive substring of any row in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`. Four required rows could therefore be deleted without the check noticing, because another row contained the name:

| Deleted row | Still matched by |
| --- | --- |
| `DS4` | `DS4 GB10/GX10 fork`, `antirez/ds4` |
| `hipBLAS` | `hipBLASLt` |
| `llama.cpp / ggml` | `llama.cpp reference builds` |
| `Torchvision` | `Torchvision AlexNet weights` |

Change:
- Required components must match a row name exactly. Four entries now use their full row names: `ccv TensorOps ancestry`, `llama.cpp / ggml`, `curl / libcurl` and `PyTorch ROCm`.
- A missing `--package-nix` or `--flake-nix` file is now an error. Before, the binding checks for that file were silently skipped. Both files are already in the Nix check's filtered source.

`tests/tools/check_dependencies_test.py` (registered as `check_dependencies_test` in CTest and the hosted `check-pr` list) checks three things: the real inventory passes, deleting each required row fails, and a missing Nix file fails.

Built in a cloud session (CPU only); Strix Halo validation pending.

> AI disclosure: I am not a software developer. Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) developed and tested this patch; this is not a claim of human developer review. Claude Code cloud session, CPU only, no GPU testing.

Test scope (Linux x86-64 cloud VM, no GPU, system Python 3):
- `python3 tools/ci/check-dependencies.py` on this branch: PASS (36 dependencies).
- `python3 tests/tools/check_dependencies_test.py`: OK (3 tests). I deleted each row above from a copy of `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and ran the unpatched script: it exited 0 for all four.
- `cmake --preset cpu-test && cmake --build --preset pr --parallel 4`: 55/55 hosted tests passed, including the new test.
- `nix build .#checks.x86_64-linux.dependency-inventory`: built (result: "PASS: Dependency inventory clean"). `tools/ci/check-pr-title.py`: PASS.
